svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"garment-blues-class-b-shirt-male-long-epaulet-sleeve-officer","name":"Men's Class B blue long-sleeve shirt adult officer epaulet sleeves (overlay, registered to garment-blues-class-b-shirt-male-long; blank grade)","size_in":{"w":25.8626,"h":32.9106},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,2586.26,3291.06],"size_source":"estimated","size_basis":"Edge-on band (0.46 in thick, LIVE10-ART 2: the Class A coat's edge-on strip) = the garment epaulet strap's band, its upper edge the shoulder line (the silhouette, not stroked), flush with the armhole seam, over the outer 82 % of the strap's length to its tip (the pointed end and the button stay bare), the way the sleeve looks from the front; epaulet_sleeve_poly_<side> is that polygon; the full sleeve is the separate top-down asset garment-blues-class-b-epaulet-top-*.
